(Japanese: '''１番道路のとおせんぼ''' ''Obstruction on Route 1'') is the first chapter of the [[Pocket Monsters BW: Good Partners]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Takurō]] and [[Mashiro]] begin their {{pkmn|journey}}, but are unable to get past something blocking the way to {{rt|1|Unova}}.
* Takurō and Mashiro discover the culprit is a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Scraggy}} trying to keep people away from an injured {{p|Emolga}}.
* Takurō and Mashiro convince Scraggy to let them catch Emolga in a [[Heal Ball]] so that they can heal its injuries.
* Scraggy allows Mashiro to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} Emolga and lets itself be caught by Takurō.
